svg.title: ICN-EWTW-021000010-001-01 - eWTW ECS general arrangement and cabin zoning
svg.desc: Plan view of ECS control zones and air distribution, and side elevation of lower-lobe compartments and ventilation path, for the AMPEL360 eWTW bleedless electric ECS.
svg.text: ECS GENERAL ARRANGEMENT AND CABIN ZONING · 021-000-010 · COMMON INFORMATION OBJECT · PUBLICATION-NEUTRAL MASTER
VIEW A — PLAN VIEW · ECS CONTROL ZONES AND AIR DISTRIBUTION
VIEW B — SIDE ELEVATION · LOWER-LOBE COMPARTMENTS AND VENTILATION PATH

g.text: Ram-air inlet / exit (L and R), pack heat-sink circuit
Recirculation fan and HEPA filter (L and R)
Conditioned-air distribution trunk and zone risers
Zone temperature trim valve (FD, Z1, Z2, Z3)
UF Under-floor compartments (E-E, cargo, battery bay)
GENERAL ARRANGEMENT · CABIN ZONES · AIR DISTRIBUTION
1 The eWTW ECS is a bleedless, all-electric architecture: both packs are motor-driven compressor units; no engine bleed air is used.
2 Zone boundaries ZB-1 / ZB-2 / ZB-3 are ECS control boundaries and do not necessarily coincide with structural station breaks.
3 The under-floor battery bay (REF 053-900) uses a dedicated, smoke-isolated ventilation and thermal-management circuit, segregated from cabin air.
4 For distribution detail refer to 021-020; for pressurization control refer to 021-030; for pack detail refer to 021-050.
5 Callout items 1–12: see ITEM · NOMENCLATURE. Airflow direction symbols: see AIRFLOW KEY.
